children.tooltip: Dexterity +7: This item makes the wearer more nimble and dexterous, granting a +7 Enhancement bonus to Dexterity.
Insightful Dexterity +2: This item makes the wearer more nimble and dexterous, granting a +2 Insight bonus to Dexterity.
Wisdom +7: This item makes the wearer more in tune with her surroundings, granting a +7 Enhancement bonus to Wisdom.
Insightful Wisdom +2: This item makes the wearer more in tune with her surroundings, granting a +2 Insight bonus to Wisdom.

enchantments.tooltip: Sneak Attack Bonus +5 : Provides a +5 Enhancement modifier to your attack bonus and a +8 Enhancement bonus to damage for any attack that would qualify as a Sneak Attack, even if the wielder is not a Rogue.

Insightful Sneak Attack Bonus +3 : Provides a +3 Insightful modifier to your attack bonus and a +5 Insightful bonus to damage for any attack that would qualify as a Sneak Attack, even if the wielder is not a Rogue.

Improved Deception: This item makes your weapons hard to focus upon and thus provides a +5 enhancement bonus to Bluff checks. In addition, while using this item your weapons have a chance to envelop the target in darkness, making them vulnerable to sneak attacks for a short time.
Mythic Ring Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
